## Change

Describe the behavior changed and who uses it. Link related issues, if any.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `make check`, or listed the checks run and why others were skipped.
- [ ] Updated the relevant setup or protocol guide if behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, flash backups or operator state are included.

List commands and results. Local contributor checks do not require a radio.
If live testing was separately authorized, name the setup and whether it
transmitted, rebooted, erased data or changed identities. Do not imply physical
radio validation when only local tests ran.
